data_fields.name: restart_delay_s
data_fields.donor_constant: Utility.Random(1, 5) * 30 as default (1 to 4 x 30 s if Random is exclusive as read); overridable per quest

data_fields.name: objective_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: All (default); Any is the other value

data_fields.name: objective_duration_s
data_fields.donor_constant: TimeSpan given to TimedKillObjective and TimedDeliverObjective; end = now + duration

best_idea: A quest is an instance with a list of objectives, a mode (all or any), an expiry per timed objective and a claimable state that only a capacity-checked claim can clear; the giver's dialogue is a four-rule cascade (running, hand-in, chain, random).
decision_why: The instance state machine and the giver cascade fit zones as data and the one ledger; quests must be rows (the donor writes each quest as a class), the chain walk gets a cycle guard, and the expired-delivery rule is written down, not inherited as an open question.
acceptance: A server test: a 2-objective all-mode quest with a 60 s timed kill objective fails when the timer expires and the player gets the expiry message; a claim with a full pack leaves the quest claimable and pays nothing; a one-time quest cannot be offered twice; a chain fixture that loops back returns without hanging.
